name: Woeful Permutation
justification: Neat lcm(i,i+1)=i(i+1) insight; optimum is unique so token checker suffices despite 'print any'.
solution_sketch: lcm(i,p_i) <= i*p_i with equality iff coprime; pairing consecutive integers (swap n with n-1, n-2 with n-3, ...) maximizes the sum. For odd n, 1 stays fixed. Verified by exhaustion that the optimum is unique for n<=8.
